title: docs: isolate header from other documentation style
body: Our style examples should be safe now.

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @bobylito and @vvo to be potential reviewers
Can you point or explain the part that effectively avoid merging styles from header in examples as described in #1614? Thanks

I created an header.scss file to separate the header styles from the rest of the documentation styles. Then our examples are now only using this file to avoid conflict. 

It works fine, except for the material-ui one (there is conflict with z-index/webkit- properties) but for the others, it seems to be enough.
